data.body: debug-everything 2026-05-08: Description empty (Jira-mirror ticket without backing local description). Cannot investigate root cause without (a) reproducible failure log from inbound bridge workflow, (b) state of tickets branch on remote at time of failure, or (c) the failing GitHub Actions run URL. ESCALATED — leave open. Recommended: human reporter to add 'Incident Overview' section per skills/create-bug/SKILL.md template, then re-queue via /dso:debug-everything.
